articles.title: 科学大模型的起点：数据如何成为科学知识
articles.summary: 从科学对象的表示、知识层次与证据条件出发，讨论数据如何成为可用于研究的科学知识。
articles.titleEn: Where Scientific Large Models Begin: Turning Data into Scientific Knowledge
articles.summaryEn: Starting with representations of scientific objects, layers of knowledge, and the evidence needed to support claims, this article explores how data becomes usable scientific knowledge.

articles.title: 科学大模型的能力从何而来：从预训练到任务学习
articles.badge: 科学大模型的能力从何而来
articles.summary: 沿着表示、预训练、后训练与任务反馈的路径，理解科学大模型的能力怎样形成，以及哪些能力需要额外建立。
keywords: 科学大模型的能力从何而来
articles.titleEn: Where Scientific Large Models Get Their Capabilities: From Pretraining to Task Learning
articles.summaryEn: Follow the path from representations and pretraining to post-training and task feedback to understand how scientific model capabilities develop, and which capabilities need further work.

articles.title: 科学大模型的高分，究竟证明了什么？
articles.badge: 科学大模型的高分，究竟证明了什么
articles.summary: 从任务、指标、参考答案、裁判和测试条件出发，区分科学大模型的高分究竟支持哪一层能力结论。
keywords: 科学大模型的高分，究竟证明了什么
articles.titleEn: What Do High Scores in Scientific Large Models Actually Prove?
articles.summaryEn: Examine tasks, metrics, reference answers, evaluators, and test conditions to distinguish which capability claims a high score can support.

articles.title: 科研智能体走向发现，还缺少怎样的数据生态？
articles.summary: 科研智能体如何调用工具、理解失败并调整计划？本篇沿着研究循环，讨论可追溯的数据、反馈和持续积累的科学证据。
articles.titleEn: What Data Ecosystem Do Scientific Agents Need to Make Discoveries?
articles.summaryEn: How do scientific agents use tools, learn from failure, and revise plans? This article follows the research cycle to examine traceable data, feedback, and the accumulation of scientific evidence.

articles.title: Agentic Science：当 AI 开始参与科学研究的下一步
articles.summary: 从单次作答走向持续研究：围绕目标规划、执行与反馈，考察 AI 参与科研下一步的机制、实例与验证边界。
articles.titleEn: Agentic Science: When AI Starts Taking the Next Step in Research
articles.summaryEn: From answering once to conducting sustained research: explore how AI plans, acts, and uses feedback, with attention to concrete examples and the limits of validation.

articles.title: 科学基础模型：从任务专用走向跨问题迁移
articles.summary: 从任务专用代理模型走向跨问题迁移，梳理科学基础模型的定义、适配与泛化能力，以及物理和数值验证要求。
articles.titleEn: Scientific Foundation Models: From Task-Specific Models to Transfer Across Problems
articles.summaryEn: Explore the definitions, adaptation, and generalization of scientific foundation models, and the physical and numerical validation required as models move beyond individual tasks.

articles.title: 科学知识建模：从异构数据走向可推理的科学知识
articles.summary: 把科学对象、关系、适用条件与证据组织成可计算的知识，理解知识图谱与大模型怎样协同支持预测和假设生成。
articles.titleEn: Scientific Knowledge Modeling: From Heterogeneous Data to Knowledge We Can Reason With
articles.summaryEn: Organize scientific objects, relationships, conditions, and evidence into computable knowledge, and examine how knowledge graphs and large models support prediction and hypothesis generation.

articles.title: S1-Omni：让科学推理连接预测、结构与图像生成
articles.subtitle: 共享任务表示，如何驱动不同的科学输出
articles.summary: 共享视觉语言主干理解任务和组织证据，再由专业解码器输出数值、位点、结构与图像，检验统一表示的收益和边界。
articles.titleEn: S1-Omni: Connecting Scientific Reasoning with Prediction, Structures, and Image Generation
articles.summaryEn: A shared vision-language backbone interprets tasks and organizes evidence, while specialized decoders produce values, binding sites, structures, and images. Examine the benefits and limits of a unified representation.

articles.title: BioMatrix：让分子、蛋白质的序列与结构进入同一个模型
articles.subtitle: 从统一离散表示，到跨模态与跨实体建模
articles.summary: BioMatrix 把分子、蛋白质的序列与三维结构转成可共同学习的离散 Token，让同一自回归主干既能读取，也能生成这些表示。
articles.titleEn: BioMatrix: Bringing Molecular and Protein Sequences and Structures into One Model
articles.summaryEn: BioMatrix converts molecular and protein sequences and 3D structures into discrete tokens that can be learned together, enabling a single autoregressive backbone to read and generate these representations.

articles.title: LOGOS：用统一科学语法连接分子、蛋白质与材料
articles.subtitle: 从科学对象与关系的序列化，到跨领域生成
articles.summary: 通过统一科学语法组织蛋白质、小分子、化学反应与材料，把对象之间的显式关系接入共同的生成式学习。
articles.titleEn: LOGOS: A Unified Scientific Grammar for Molecules, Proteins, and Materials
articles.summaryEn: A unified scientific grammar organizes proteins, small molecules, chemical reactions, and materials, incorporating explicit relationships between objects into shared generative learning.

articles.title: 科学基础模型的预训练：几种描述，如何共同参与学习？
articles.summary: 以分子的多模态表示为例，理解遮蔽恢复、跨模态对齐、信息融合怎样参与预训练，以及预训练如何衔接下游性质预测。
keywords: 科学基础模型的预训练
articles.titleEn: Scientific Foundation Model Pretraining: How Multiple Representations Learn Together
articles.summaryEn: Explore molecular representations, masked recovery, cross-modal alignment and information fusion, and how multimodal pretraining connects to downstream property prediction.

articles.title: 科学数据如何进入AI4S 模型？
articles.subtitle: 以 CatalystBench 为例，看研究记录怎样成为可学习、可检验的任务样本。
articles.summary: 以 CatalystBench 为例，追踪研究记录怎样经过整理、任务构建、质量检查与评估，成为可学习、可检验的科学数据。
keywords: 科学数据如何进入AI4S 模型
articles.titleEn: How Scientific Data Enters AI4S Models
articles.summaryEn: Using CatalystBench, follow how research records are curated, organized into tasks, checked for quality and evaluated as learnable, testable scientific data.

articles.title: 多智能体如何把临床数据转化为研发线索？
articles.subtitle: 以 Virtual Biotech 为例，看专业分工、临床试验整理与单细胞分析怎样形成可检验的研发线索。
articles.summary: 以 Virtual Biotech 为例，解析专业智能体的分工，以及临床试验整理与单细胞分析如何形成可检验的研发线索。
keywords: 多智能体如何把临床数据转化为研发线索
articles.titleEn: How Multiple Agents Turn Clinical Data into Research Leads
articles.summaryEn: Examine the division of work in Virtual Biotech and how clinical trial curation and single-cell analysis produce research leads that can be further tested.

articles.title: 多智能体如何提出并检验治疗假设？
articles.subtitle: 以 Virtual Biotech 为例，看肺癌治疗假设与临床失败分析怎样连接证据、审查和验证。
articles.summary: 沿着 Virtual Biotech 的肺癌治疗假设与临床失败分析，理解多智能体如何连接证据、科学审查和后续验证。
keywords: 多智能体如何提出并检验治疗假设
articles.titleEn: How Multiple Agents Propose and Test Therapeutic Hypotheses
articles.summaryEn: Follow lung cancer hypotheses and clinical failure analysis in Virtual Biotech to understand how multiple agents connect evidence, scientific review and further validation.

articles.title: 科学智能体的 Harness 如何支撑科研任务执行？
articles.subtitle: 以 Nature 的 AI Scientist 为例
articles.summary: 以 AI Scientist 为例，理解 Harness 如何组织研究构思、分阶段实验、运行记录、论文写作与评审，支撑科研任务执行。
keywords: 科学智能体的 Harness 如何支撑科研任务执行
articles.titleEn: How a Scientific Agent Harness Supports Research Execution
articles.summaryEn: Using AI Scientist, explore how a harness organizes research ideas, staged experiments, execution records, paper writing and review to support scientific research tasks.

articles.title: HLE：常用试卷接近满分之后，怎样测量大模型的能力边界？
articles.subtitle: 以 HLE 为例，理解专家级题目的构建、评测与能力边界。
articles.summary: 以 Humanity’s Last Exam 为例，梳理专家级题目的构建、难度筛选与审核，理解准确率、置信度校准及专业答题与自主科研之间的能力边界。
articles.titleEn: HLE: Measuring the Limits of Large Models Beyond Saturated Benchmarks
articles.summaryEn: Explore how Humanity’s Last Exam builds, screens and reviews expert-level questions, and what accuracy and confidence calibration reveal about the gap between answering questions and conducting research.

articles.title: 自主实验室（一）：干湿闭环基本原理与化学实践
articles.summary: 从自主实验室与干湿闭环的基本原理出发，结合 RoboChem-Flex、Flex-Cat 与移动机器人化学家，理解实验选择、设备执行和测量反馈怎样连接成持续运行的研究过程。
articles.titleEn: Autonomous Laboratories (I): Dry–Wet Loop Fundamentals and Chemical Practice
articles.summaryEn: Explore the foundations of autonomous laboratories and dry–wet feedback loops through RoboChem-Flex, Flex-Cat and a mobile robotic chemist, following how experiment selection, execution and measurements guide the next step.
